author_canon.statement: RRR is a post-apocalyptic nuclear-wasteland hobby and racing world.
Rad roaches assimilate parts from other insects; the biological premise is fictional.
The founding rivalry escalates from beetle horn to mantis pincers to grasshopper jumping legs, with the jumper winning the race.
The mature circuit setting is thirty years after the founding-rivalry era.
Locals lead to Regionals, then Factionals, then faction representation in New World City for the What’s Left of the World Derby.
Open is the most famous competitive class and embraces no-holds-barred builds; entry to the world championship still requires qualification.
The All-Out Offensive circuit requires a minimum offensive build and light carapace.
Speedsters prohibit weapon modules, while native violence and contact can occur.
The world mirrors PCR’s build-and-race hobby, with its own execution and identity in the sense of Mutant League’s relationship to conventional sport.
Speed, race victories, desirable upgrades, collecting, personal assembly and showing off are legitimate central pleasures.
A Wrangloid is a successful insect-catching and breeding hobbyist who turns that success into a livelihood.
Wrangloid shops resemble fish stores, with whole living insects varying in rarity, quality and price.
Anyone may search for, catch and breed insects. Expertise and discovery matter; this is not a profession-exclusive permission.
RRR is a large sandbox with accessible participation and optional depth for advanced users.
Racing remains racing; the user did not specify last-roach-standing races.

working_proposals.statement: A native host is functional before modification; whole assemblies can satisfy several racing functions.
Installed grafts are not automatically copied into offspring.
Physical extraction updates the donor’s anatomy; vital-organ preparation consumes the donor.
The racing hobby uses portable creatures, transport cases and bench assembly; exact scale is unset.
Switchyard hoppers, Kilnback scarabs, Saltglass mantises, Gutterbred hosts and named starter kits are candidate world content.

reference_facts.statement: Gaiden places Pocket Circuit in CourStar, with a coordinator, parts acquisition, Time Attack and Rival modes.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Translate the named venue, recurring people and reasons to revisit, alongside racing.

reference_facts.statement: Tamiya separates motors, gearing, tires, rollers, brakes and dampers as interacting tuning functions.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Preserve causal roles; do not flatten them into interchangeable speed bonuses.

reference_facts.statement: Tamiya records its first Mini 4WD release in July 1982 and cumulative series sales exceeding 100 million units in December 1995.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Give RRR product generations and hobby history. Do not interpret these numbers as current market size.

reference_facts.statement: Rowdy Bull starter pack 18710 bundles an assembly kit with a motor, tires, brakes, dampers and plates.
reference_facts.translation_insight: A coordinated beginner kit can include interesting upgrades without requiring separate expert procurement.

reference_facts.statement: The Station directory distinguishes shop identities and facilities, including installed circuits.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Model breeder, retailer and venue roles independently; some businesses combine them.

reference_facts.statement: Tamiya offers local-event resources including circuit loans, layouts, organizer instructions and event publicity.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Traveling course stock and local hosts can extend the hobby beyond permanent arenas.

reference_facts.statement: Official car limits include width under 105 mm, length under 165 mm, height under 70 mm and mass at least 90 g; straight lanes are 115 mm wide with 50 mm walls.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Keep source dimensions separate from RRR scale. Racer and course dimensions are a coupled design decision.

reference_facts.statement: The rules specify starts, inspection, finish classification, disqualification and objection procedures; deliberate damage and obstruction are prohibited.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Translate race administration while deliberately changing the contact rules for RRR.

reference_facts.statement: Japan Cup 2026 publishes an identified course and has a final for specified class winners from its venue events.
reference_facts.translation_insight: A season can connect course reveals, travel, rivalries and culminating qualification.

reference_facts.statement: The official 2026–27 guide combines a catalogue, build techniques, race preparation, rules and champion-machine galleries.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Create an in-world publication people use, collect, annotate and argue about.

reference_facts.statement: Tamiya distinguishes continuously produced products, revived products, intermittently produced projects and genuinely limited releases.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Separate RRR brood availability and historic editions from performance quality.

reference_facts.statement: The layout sheet includes piece lists, footprints and routes assembled from differing numbers of circuit sets, including historic recreations.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Track plans are reproducible construction recipes and collectible hobby artifacts.

reference_facts.statement: Tamiya publicly supports appearance contests, selected build galleries and interviews with successful appearance-contest entrants.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Craft and visual prestige can develop alongside race prestige.

reference_facts.statement: In Issus, paired hind-leg gears synchronize nymphal jumps; this gear mechanism is absent after the final molt to adulthood.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Life stage can change the kind of useful sect, not merely its item level.

reference_facts.statement: The participation guide distinguishes Family, Junior, Open and Trial categories, with differing eligibility and assembly arrangements.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Separate participant category from equipment class and competitive tier.

reference_facts.statement: A Station Challenge listing specifies shop registration plus distinct Dash and Tune conditions.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Store a versioned event rule set rather than assuming every club uses identical rules.

translation_rules.title: Function before renamed appearance
translation_rules.rule: Map a PCR part’s job, interactions, tuning choices and failure behavior before giving it an insect appearance.

translation_rules.title: Keep sources scoped
translation_rules.rule: A rule in Gaiden, a Tamiya event and an RRR class are different records even when their names match.

translation_rules.title: Shared biology, multiple acquisition routes
translation_rules.rule: Wild sourcing, home breeding and Wrangloid retail feed the same specimen and sect systems.

translation_rules.title: Real upgrades are allowed
translation_rules.rule: Do not impose an artificial drawback on every improvement. Good stock and clever engineering can outperform earlier stock.

translation_rules.title: Price is not truth
translation_rules.rule: Asking price, measured performance, pedigree evidence, rarity and condition are separate fields.

translation_rules.title: Anatomy is not a loot table
translation_rules.rule: A donor’s usable pieces, stage and remaining state must agree with actual preparation events.

translation_rules.title: Assemblies are compositional
translation_rules.rule: An integrated hopper leg can include support, leverage and spring response. Count those contributions once, not again as hidden bonuses.

translation_rules.title: Compatibility is expressed
translation_rules.rule: Where proposed geometry prevents a combination, specify the interference and allow redesign rather than inventing a species gate.

translation_rules.title: Products differ from individuals
translation_rules.rule: A kit recipe or breeder line is repeatable; each live specimen and assembled racer has its own identity and history.

translation_rules.title: Victory enters the world
translation_rules.rule: Results create records and opportunities; subsequent reputation and demand travel through identified people and media.

translation_rules.title: Depth is elective
translation_rules.rule: A kit-only racer, specialist collector and full-time breeder each have complete routes to meaningful enjoyment and progress.

translation_rules.title: Thirty years has layers
translation_rules.rule: Write hobby history using relative sport years while leaving the apocalypse’s date unresolved.

translation_rules.title: Fictional uncertainty is typed
translation_rules.rule: A rumor, a merchant claim, a measured observation and author-established truth must not collapse into one fact.

translation_rules.title: Physical resemblance is insufficient
translation_rules.rule: A gear-looking spine is not a gearbox; a passive foil is not a flight engine; a familiar name is not a functional model.

decisions.title: Survival chronology and biosphere
decisions.consequences: Determines why people, donors and roaches coexist, and what feeds settlements.
decisions.proposed_direction: Keep sport age separate from apocalypse age. Retain roach survival as the premise; resolve the return or survival of other life explicitly.
unapproved_assumptions: All life other than roaches literally ceased to exist

decisions.title: Creature and venue scale
decisions.consequences: Controls carrying cases, tool handling, camera, tank density, track pieces and spectacle.
decisions.proposed_direction: Use a bench-built, hand-carried hobby as a working visual anchor; leave millimeter values unset until a scale study.
unapproved_assumptions: Every race is an arena of human-sized mounts

decisions.title: Assimilation operation and timing
decisions.consequences: Controls wild grafting, prepared kits, reconfiguration and experimentation.
decisions.proposed_direction: Raw sects and prepared sects use the same underlying mutation; preparation supplies convenience, fit and information.
unapproved_assumptions: Proprietary collars required to make assimilation possible
Instant or multi-day integration already settled

decisions.title: Removal, storage and reinstallation
decisions.consequences: Controls component collection, used markets, bench swapping and maintenance.
decisions.proposed_direction: Track removed, prepared and installed states distinctly; specify preservation and damage only after the life-cycle model is chosen.

decisions.title: Heredity and breeding compatibility
decisions.consequences: Controls commercial lines, host identity and accidental infinite reproduction of builds.
decisions.proposed_direction: Retain the v0.2 separation of acquired grafts and inherited lineage as the current working branch.
unapproved_assumptions: Installed assemblies copied perfectly into offspring

decisions.title: Life stages and usable anatomy
decisions.consequences: Controls catching seasons, stage-specific stock, breeding parents and preparation opportunities.
decisions.proposed_direction: Describe stage-specific anatomy per donor. Do not require every family to share a simple growing rarity ladder.
unapproved_assumptions: Adult is always the only valuable stage

decisions.title: Injury, recovery, aging and permanent loss
decisions.consequences: Controls emotional attachment, preparation demand, risk, competition formats and accessibility.
decisions.proposed_direction: Evaluate repair/recovery and high-risk event alternatives explicitly; do not silently set a global death model.
unapproved_assumptions: Imported real lifespans are game timers

decisions.title: Locomotion, senses and player intervention
decisions.consequences: Controls whether the host is a creature, control input depth, training and observable racing behavior.
decisions.proposed_direction: Provide an autonomous race plan as a candidate. Resolve live cues and behavioral inheritance before adding them to kit requirements.

decisions.title: Calendar and simulation clocks
decisions.consequences: Controls hatching, market delivery, event schedules and catch availability.
decisions.proposed_direction: Declare world time, active-play time and optional time advancement separately. Beginners can use shop stock without becoming breeders.
unapproved_assumptions: Waiting is the only way to breed

decisions.title: Trade and communications
decisions.consequences: Controls how live stock travels and how distant people learn about winners.
decisions.proposed_direction: Prototype protected live-stock routes, local handbills and intermittent regional broadcasts.
unapproved_assumptions: A collapsed world has no working maintenance industry

decisions.title: Faction representation and Derby jurisdiction
decisions.consequences: Controls who selects representatives, recognizes results and protects visiting racers.
decisions.proposed_direction: Factionals award representation; recognition of race results can be narrower than political friendship.
unapproved_assumptions: A faction grants exclusive biological compatibility

decisions.title: Event standards and extraordinary builds
decisions.consequences: Controls Open freedom, flight boundaries, course validity and disputes.
decisions.proposed_direction: Separate locomotion division, equipment policy, qualification and race format; inspect only relevant declared conditions.
unapproved_assumptions: No-holds-barred means no start or finish rules
Every nominal slot permits only one physical item

causal_rules.effect: Create or transfer a particular specimen; store origin and observed condition. Do not grant every donor module as an automatic unlock.
Create new identities with declared lineage evidence. Parameters of heredity remain explicit design data.
Update consumed anatomy and output identity together. Never keep a sold whole donor unchanged after extraction.
Transfer actual ownership and currency only when values and stock are known. Do not duplicate a unique specimen.
Preserve host identity; create a new build version and recalculate derived functions.
Record finish order, eligibility and conditions before awarding titles or public claims.
Update knowledge of reachable audiences; fame is not instant global omniscience.
Update inquiries or bids; sale price need not change everywhere or in lockstep.
Consume available sections into a versioned layout; check geometry rather than assuming a list of pieces forms a circuit.
Keep the historical rumor and record the correction; do not rewrite all people as if they always knew.

scenario_fixtures.input: An inexperienced player catches an exceptional donor.
scenario_fixtures.expected: They can retain, test, sell, breed or use it subject to actual condition and established biology; race rank does not invalidate the discovery.

scenario_fixtures.input: A player buys only prepared kits and never breeds.
scenario_fixtures.expected: They can build, race, win and participate socially; breeding is not an invisible progression prerequisite.

scenario_fixtures.input: A rare-looking insect has no measurements or known pedigree.
scenario_fixtures.expected: Describe visual rarity claims and unknown performance separately; do not invent an exact tier.

scenario_fixtures.input: A horn and shell vane seem to overlap.
scenario_fixtures.expected: Show geometry and consider alternate placement; do not impose a universal one-brow-item law.

scenario_fixtures.input: Second Breakfast changes legs after winning.
scenario_fixtures.expected: The host keeps its history, while the winning build remains an immutable prior configuration.

scenario_fixtures.input: A merchant sells a specimen after extracting its hind legs.
scenario_fixtures.expected: The listing must reflect changed anatomy; an intact duplicate is invalid.

scenario_fixtures.input: An unknown racer arrives at New World City with a magnificent Open build.
scenario_fixtures.expected: Build freedom does not substitute for the specified qualifying route.

scenario_fixtures.input: A distant breeder has not received news of a local win.
scenario_fixtures.expected: They do not automatically raise prices or recognize the winner.

scenario_fixtures.input: An agent needs the game’s death or inherited-graft rule.
scenario_fixtures.expected: Retrieve the unresolved decision or working branch, not present an invented choice as author canon.

scenario_fixtures.input: A track recipe lists bends and straights.
scenario_fixtures.expected: Treat it as a concept until connections, geometry and closed route are validated.
